posts: Cut contract binary from 245KB to 189KB by swapping serde_json for borsh on storage reads. Same schema, deserialization dropped from ~1.9ms to ~1.2ms in my testnet bench. #near #rust
Profiled state_read vs log emission today: a 4KB state read costs ~11 Tgas, a log line ~3. Moved cold metadata to logs, kept hot paths in state. Gas per call down 22%. #near #fastdata
